verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack shows that Canva's native design file format is open or documented. The OpenAPI description covers the REST APIs, not the design format. Exports to PDF, PNG, PPTX and MP4 are a separate export capability that produces derived outputs, so they do not make the native designs portable or toolable outside the editor.

support.subject: As a developer, the file format is open or documented, so my designs stay portable and toolable outside the vendor's editor
